situations.headline: Glenstone's 71.4p cash offer for AIRE nears completion, condition extended to 11 Sept 2026

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Glenstone's 71.4p cash offer for AIRE nears completion, condition extended to 11 Sept 2026 (interest 6, risk 2)

thesis.text: AIRE is in the final stretch of a recommended/contested cash takeover by Glenstone REIT at 71.4p/share; with acceptances plus concert-party holdings at 49.89% versus the 50% Acceptance Condition and the Unconditional Date extended one week to 11 September 2026, the situation is a near-term binary cash-completion event with limited remaining spread risk, warranting close monitoring of the next acceptance update or unconditional announcement.
